what: Latency of task 145's two DSRC pipeline stages, segment_assemble and dsrc_infer, measured on this development machine. THIS IS NOT THE ORIN MEASUREMENT that plan_task145 step 12 asks for; no device was reachable this session.
input_source: synthetic (no --here-log given): one link near each Mainz segment's first polyline point

provenance.commit_subject: task145 validator round 2 fixup: drop the tautological per_segment_changed assertion R2-2 added
provenance.where_it_ran: A detached git worktree at this commit, deliberately NOT the live tree: at the time of measurement the live tree was at a different commit and carried another agent's uncommitted work, so its HEAD would not have described the code that produced these numbers.
provenance.policy_bundle: deployment/jetson/models/dsrc_policy.{ts,json} (gitignored; copied into the worktree). The bench also re-exports its own bundle to a temp dir at startup, which is what it actually measures.
provenance.correction: An earlier write of this file recorded the LIVE tree's HEAD (8a321fd1, dirty) rather than the worktree's. That was wrong: the bench never ran against 8a321fd1. Corrected before this file was committed.

environment.concurrent_load: Repeat 0 ran with the machine comparatively idle. Repeats 1-3 ran while task 143's mutation gate was driving the full deployment/jetson/tests/ suite in another worktree. This is recorded because it moved one of the two numbers: see contention_effect below.

contention_effect.statement: segment_assemble p50 is insensitive to the concurrent suite: 29.91 to 30.16 ms across four repeats, a spread of 0.25 ms on a ~30 ms quantity. dsrc_infer p50 is not: it was 0.0274 ms on the idle repeat and 0.0417 to 0.0539 ms on the three contended ones, so the contended figure is roughly 1.5 to 2 times the idle one. Both stages remain more than three orders of magnitude inside the 60 s decision interval either way, so the contention changes no conclusion; it is recorded so the two dsrc_infer figures in item 145's record can be reconciled rather than read as a regression.

what_this_does_not_establish: The Orin latency. plan_task145 step 12's deliverable needs the device and no device was reachable.

Behaviour on a recorded drive. --here-log was not given, so the input is synthetic full-coverage links, which is the favourable case: every segment matches, so dsrc_infer runs every tick and segment_assemble does its full distance work every tick.
Anything about the advisory's correctness. This measures only how long two stages take.
